news.title: Skyborne Now Get Reputation Discount for Mounts in WoW: Forever But You'll Need A Lot of Runecloth
news.description: Skyborne now get a 10% reputation discount for mounts in WoW: Forever when they hit Honored. Get your Runecloth turn-ins ready!
news.details:
WoW: Forever Mount Guide
With the release of WoW: Forever, players noticed that the Skyborne don't get a 10% discount with mount vendors. With new hotfixes, Blizzard has fixed the Skyborne race mount vendor, and it now gives a discount to players who are Honored!
This makes the Epic Riding cost .
A Small Problem
As pointed out in our last article, there's a small problem with the Skyborne reputation: players don't get it naturally by questing like the other faction reputations. Unless something has changed, the only way to gain reputation with High Order (Alliance) or Windshapers (Horde) past Friendly is through cloth turn-ins, as after you leave the starting area of Zephras Isle, there are no further quests that increase your reputation with the Skyborne factions.
If you want the Honored discount, you need to complete the initial three cloth turn-ins for Wool Cloth, Silk Cloth, or…

news.description: Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes a Ret Paladin bug fix and making the Seed Hybridizer available again!
news.details:

November 19, 2026

Seed Hybridization now has adjusted values, as well as a chance of failure when combining seeds.
Scarce Herb Seeds are no longer able to be used in the Seed Hybridizer.
Classes
Paladin
Retribution
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now correctly increases all Holy Damage you deal while a two-handed weapon is equipped.
Dungeons
City of Dalaran
Shade of the Archmage should no longer despawn immediately upon entering combat.
The Shaper’s Terrace
Vitrix’s Poison Shock now deals less damage.

news.title: Blizzard Investigating Several Bugged Quests in WoW: Forever
news.description: The official BlizzardCS account has commented on several quests in Wowhead's database, letting players know they are investigating bugs.
news.details:
As Blizzard continues to squash bugs, three quests (Call of Earth, Biding Our Time, and Witch Doctor Ti'ik) have specifically been called out as not working as intended, and BlizzardCS has stated the issues are being investigated.
For two quests, Call of Earth and Witch Doctor Ti'ik, players had left very few or no comments at all detailing the bugs (although there was definitely some frustration about Ti'ik's Head).
We're aware that completing the quest as a level 3 Skyborne Shaman does not grant Stoneskin Totem spell. We're already investigating this issue.
We're aware that Ti'ik's Head only drops for one party member when completing the quest in a group. We're already investigating this issue.
Biding Our Time, however, had a bit more context in database comments. Several players reported that Filcher's Cowl was unusable, with the reward showing as a red question mark, but some…

news.title: Blizzard Addresses Spell Power Gear Shortage in WoW: Forever
news.description: In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, developers Kris Zierhut and Aidan Moon address the concern about a lack of Spell Power gear in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
As players are leveling their Mages, Warlocks, and other spellcaster classes, they've noticed a lack of proper Spell Power gear in the game. In WoW: Forever, Caster classes had their baseline damage reduced, but it was intended for new gear to be added to make up for that, so getting gear felt as important as it did for melee classes. However, players feel as though there isn't enough of that gear in the game currently.
"As you're leveling up a spellcaster, you really don't care about your gear that much, and I really wanted to fix that problem and make spell casters care as much about their gear as Warriors and Rogues do.... That being said, I think there probably is not enough Spell Power gear leveling up. As I was introducing it, the design team was very wary of how much change it was, and I probably added a little bit less of it than we should. So going into future patches, I want…

news.title: Some EU Players Reporting Issues with PvP Queues and Honor Gains in WoW: Forever
news.description: Some EU players have been reporting issues with PvP queues, preventing any Battleground queues from popping.
news.details:
From multiple reports on the forums and Reddit, some players on EU servers are having trouble with the PvP systems in WoW: Foirever. Reports from these players indicate they are unable to get their Battleground queues to pop unless they get layered.
Image: Battle.net Forums
This has made people think that there are specific EU layers that are bugged and preventing all Battleground queues. Some players believe it is a specific home layer that has this bug "Layer 15".
If you're unable to queue up for Battlegrounds and get queue pop, you might be bugged and will need to ask a friend to queue for you.

news.title: Motes of Unstable Magic Now Soulbound in WoW: Forever - Gold Strategy Nerfed
news.description: Motes of Unstable Magic are now soulbound, preventing high-level players from selling them on the Auction House.
news.details:
Once you reach level 48, players can obtain the Unstable Magic in Dalaran or Unstable Magic at the Skywatcher Plateau. This quest gives players a Elemental Attractor, and when used, it gives the Magical Awareness buff. This buff will sometimes grant players a Mote of Unstable Magic when they defeat spellcasters or bosses. After you complete the initial quest, a repeatable quest (e.g. More Unstable Magic) allows players to turn in another 10 Motes for reputation and .
Because these were previously tradeable, each Mote was worth roughly . Players could buy these off the Auction House at this price to get reputation while losing no money. This quest stops being available at Honored, but players could continue getting drops and selling the Motes for extra Gold. Many players made a lot of gold from selling these, but this income has been cut off.

news.title: Blizzard Wants to Get Rid of BiS in WoW: Forever
news.description: In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Senior Game Designer Aidan Moon says he wants to get rid of the idea of BiS in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
BiS, or "Best In Slot" gear, has been something that's existed in World of Warcraft since its inception. Players have looked to theorycraft their overall "best" items for every slot, to achieve multiple stat goals such as Hit cap, Expertise Cap, Critical Strike Immunity, while also maximizing their damage, Health, or Mana. However, developer Aidan "Zirene" Moon says he wants to try to "get rid of BiS".
"I essentially want to get rid of "BiS". I think that "BiS" is not a good thing for a video game that's supposed to be about role-playing systems about it. That's why I've introduced the creature subtype system, the biome system, and in the raid, it's different... In the raid, if you go to the left wing, that's 'snowy'; if you go to the right wing, that's 'haunted', so different parts of the raid will have different biomes. So I think your BiS should be different for every single boss if…

news.title: Study The Well - WoW: Forever Podcast Board Message Hints at New Brainteaser
news.description: This Week on the WoW: Forever podcast, the board said: Study The Well. Secret Finding is on it, and it's likely to be "solved" soon!
news.details:
Each week on the WoW: Forever Podcast, there has been a board sitting behind the game developers with a different message. This week has been no different, and behind Aiden 'Zirene' Moon, the board reads: STUDY THE WELL 196.5.86.259.
The Secret Finders Discord is already across this one and has narrowed it down to a particular well in Mount Hyjal.
"Ok.... Let's make a list of every well in WoW Forever and start jumping in them"
With a steady supply of Thorium Widgets, it is all systems go for explorers looking to solve this particular mystery.
In previous weeks, the message on the board has pointed towards beta codes, co-ords pointing to a beauty spot, and secret codes. We don't yet know what this week's will point to, but it's likely to be discovered soon!

news.title: Zirene Teases Item Granting Bonus Stats When Bags are Full in WoW: Forever
news.description: Zirene has teased a new Master Looter BiS item: an item that gives bonus stats when your bags are full.
news.details:
A new WoW: Forever podcast episode was released today and on it, they discuss itemization. During this episode, Zirene is asked if there’s anything he can tease about upcoming items.
There might be an item that is Master Loot BiS.
Maybe you get extra stats if your bag is completely full.
While Zirene implied that this is a Master Loot BiS item, this would work for anyone in theory. Is the trade off of extra stats worth the inconvenience of having completely full bags?
This looks to continue the trend of weird and wacky times to shake up the meta, such as the recent discovery of a Battle Mage weapon.
